## Checklist (Ecosystem registry entries)

- [ ] The URL is reachable and stable (no redirects to a login wall, no draft links)
- [ ] The entry is in the correct section (and, for tools, the correct group)
- [ ] The entry is placed sensibly in its list (when unsure, at the top; maintainers may reorder)
- [ ] `<small>` carries the author or org, plus the publication month (`Mon YYYY`) for dated content
- [ ] The link has `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`
- [ ] The resource is not already listed in another section
- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes in the note text

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the exact snippet.
